name: get_history
title: Change history
description: Commits that changed files, communities, or projects, newest first: sha, date, author, subject, PR and issue references, whether the commit is a bug fix, and the change and line counts. Renames are followed, so a file's history includes its earlier paths (old_path). For a community or project, each commit appears once, with its lines summed over the member files. include body adds the full message; include files adds the other files the commit changed.

repo.description: Registered repository name. Optional: defaults to the repository that contains the server's working directory, or the only registered one.

targets.description: File, community, or project IDs, or path:line locators (which resolve to the file here).

since.description: Only commits on or after this time.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; keep the other arguments the same.

items.description: By target as passed, then newest first, then sha.

change.description: For a file target: added, modified, renamed, or copied.

old_path.description: The file's path in that commit, when it differs from today's path.

files.description: Other files the commit changed, by path.
